title: Label and focus every game canvas accessibly
detail: Give every game a keyboard focus target, an accessible name, linked control instructions and a visible focus ring through the shared Details adapter.

title: Preserve browser keyboard shortcuts in every game
detail: Let Ctrl, Command and Alt shortcuts reach the browser without generating gameplay actions, while still releasing keys that were held before modifiers changed.

title: Ignore IME composition when routing gameplay keys
detail: Prevent text composition and legacy IME key events from triggering jump, fire or launch actions in browser games.

title: Resynchronize gamepads after focus changes
detail: Stop sampling controllers while unfocused and invalidate cached channel values when input resets so steady held inputs are correctly resubmitted on return.

title: Release gameplay input during page lifecycle transitions
detail: Clear held input on pagehide and restore focus on pageshow, including back-forward cache restores that do not necessarily generate a window blur.

title: Release mouse button chords on capture loss
detail: Neutralize all mouse buttons when capture is cancelled, retaining pointer bookkeeping while another chord button remains held.

title: Stream Wasm compilation across all game hosts
detail: Use one streaming compiler with a single-download byte fallback when a server serves Wasm with an incompatible MIME type.

title: Bound game downloads and compilation waits
detail: Time out stalled downloads and bodies, abort network work, and provide a clear retryable error instead of leaving the loading screen indefinitely.

title: Offer visible recovery when a game cannot start
detail: Show a Retry game control on all startup failures, including missing graphics support and Courtyard shader download errors.

title: Capture screenshots from the next rendered game frame
detail: Save PNG captures immediately after each host draws so WebGL captures contain the current game rather than a discarded framebuffer.

title: Share clean game links with presentation settings
detail: Copy a game URL with the current palette and quality while excluding autoplay, debug tools, fragments and multiplayer connection addresses.

title: Keep the screen awake during visible play
detail: Offer an explicit screen wake lock with unsupported-browser feedback, hidden-tab release and safe cancellation of late lock requests.

title: Track active session time in every game
detail: Show a resettable active-session timer that excludes hidden tabs, unfocused windows and open settings panels.

title: Add an optional live performance overlay
detail: Show measured rendered FPS, framebuffer dimensions and available draw statistics without announcing changing metrics to screen readers.

title: Limit rendering to save power across all hosts
detail: Offer display-refresh, 60 FPS and 30 FPS rendering limits while allowing each simulation to receive elapsed time through its existing clock.

title: Suspend hidden game rendering and reset resume clocks
detail: Skip rendering and simulation submission in hidden documents and reset host delta clocks before the first frame after visibility returns.

title: Offer high contrast player controls
detail: Add a high contrast host UI option with bright borders and focus indicators in the shared player panel.

title: Offer larger text and targets in player settings
detail: Make shared player settings easier to read and operate with an optional larger text layout and larger controls.

title: Respect reduced motion preferences in player UI
detail: Provide system, reduced and standard motion choices for the browser player chrome; game animation and camera behavior retain their authored rules.

title: Explain offline connectivity in each game
detail: Show connection changes and explain which loaded single-player actions continue offline and which network operations need a connection.

title: Show catalog controls and objectives inside every game
detail: Load the game guide on demand from the catalog and keep custom Controls bindings authoritative.

title: Remember player preferences separately for each game
detail: Persist validated overlay, frame cap, contrast, text and UI motion preferences with safe session-only behavior when storage is unavailable.

title: Back up and restore validated player settings
detail: Export versioned JSON and import bounded validated player settings without touching gameplay saves or custom bindings.

title: Reset player settings without clearing game progress
detail: Restore default browser player settings through an explicit reset action while retaining game saves and custom controls.

title: Apply quick performance presets across the catalog
detail: Offer battery saver, balanced and sharp settings that combine existing lighting and resolution controls with the new frame cap.

title: Copy focused support diagnostics from every game
detail: Copy game ID, viewport, framebuffer and player settings for bug reports without copying peer addresses, URL queries or saved game data.

title: Rework the homepage around games and the player update
detail: Replace the generic engine landing page with gameplay-led visuals, explicit upgrade highlights and direct paths into player and developer documentation.

title: Explore all 30 changes in a searchable release catalog
detail: Filter the complete release by category, inspect individual improvements and follow their implementation PRs.

title: Document every player tool and its browser contracts
detail: Explain controls, storage, settings transfer, performance limits, capture behavior and browser support in a dedicated guide.

title: Expose the update on every game page and improve discovery
detail: Search games by title, genre and controls, combine dimension filters, and link every example to the shared upgrade guide.
